◆Assignments◆
As the Nameless traverses worlds, the Express Crew takes on assignments from across the cosmos as a means to honor the way of Trailblaze.

● Dispatch two characters to take an assignment. Complete the assignment to receive the corresponding rewards.
● For each character of recommended Path dispatched, a bonus reward will be given at the end of the assignment.
● Each character can only be dispatched on one assignment at a time.
● You can determine how long each assignment would take. The more time spent on an assignment, the better the completion rewards.
● Canceling a dispatched assignment without completing it will immediately release the dispatched characters, but no rewards will be given.
● As you progress through the story, you will be able to take on more assignments.
